title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: P&C Insurance Claims Expert
description:
*Please submit your CV in English only.


Location: Remote – based near Sao Paolo, Brazil


POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas Pleno
description:
Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Suporte a Sistemas Pleno para atuar no atendimento e resolução de incidentes em sistemas internos. Este(a) profissional será responsável por realizar análises técnicas iniciais, identificar causas de problemas e atuar de forma colaborativa com times de desenvolvimento para garantir a continuidade e estabilidade das aplicações.


Responsabilidades

  • Realizar atendimento de incidentes em nível L1/L2
  • Executar análise inicial de problemas e troubleshooting básico
  • Investigar logs e dados para identificação de falhas
  • Abrir e analisar código da aplicação para diagnóstico de issues
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas relacionados a banco de dados
  • Escalar incidentes quando necessário, com diagnóstico detalhado
  • Interagir com times técnicos (desenvolvimento e infraestrutura)
  • Garantir registro e documentação adequada dos atendimentos


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prévia com suporte a sistemas
  • Capacidade de análise inicial de incidentes e troubleshooting
  • Conhecimento intermediário em PostgreSQL (queries, análise de logs e troubleshooting)
  • Conhecimento em SQL
  • Capacidade de leitura e análise de código para identificação de problemas


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Conhecimento em IDE Visual Studio
  • Noções de desenvolvimento em .NET
  • Experiência com sistemas internos corporativos
  • Familiaridade com processos de sustentação (suporte corretivo e evolutivo)


Venha se conectar conosco!


A Softtek valoriza a diversidade e inclusão em sua força de trabalho. A empresa tem uma equipe global com pessoas de diferentes origens e culturas, o que torna o ambiente de trabalho mais rico e interessante. Independentemente da sua, etnia, idade, gênero, orientação sexual, deficiência, credo ou convicção política, o que importa são as suas competências e habilidades para fazer acontecer


Os Softtekians são seres humanos talentosos e auto-determinados que se consideram pessoas loucamente incríveis! Venha fazer parte desse time!!!


Quer saber mais? Acesse:


Sobre a Softtek : Fundada em 1982, a Softtek é uma fornecedora global de soluções de TI orientadas a processos com 30 escritórios na América do Norte, América Latina, Europa e Ásia. Com 15 centros de entrega global nos EUA, México, China, Brasil, Argentina, Costa Rica, Espanha, Hungria e Índia, a Softtek ajuda a melhorar e produzir resultados previsíveis para corporações de primeira linha em mais de 20 países. A Softtek é a criadora e líder da indústria nearshore.


Para obter mais informações sobre o que fazemos, quem somos e oportunidades de carreira, visite

@Softtek no Twitter e seja nosso fã no Facebook

title: Senior .NET and AI Engineer
description:
Senior .NET and AI Engineer

(Azure and Blazor, AI-First Environment)


About the Company:

Our client is a leading pediatric healthcare organization with a long-standing history of providing comprehensive care for infants, children, and adolescents. With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. Backed by a team of over 2,500 employees, they continue to expand and offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment for professionals across medical, operational, and administrative functions.


About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.


What You Will Do

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor
  • Build cloud-based solutions on Azure
  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures
  • Use AI tools to improve development speed and quality
  • Build and integrate AI-powered features into products


What We Are Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional C# / .NET development experience
  • Strong ASP.NET Core fundamentals — Web API, middleware, dependency injection, minimal APIs
  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar
  • Entity Framework Core — schema design, migrations, query optimization, and knowing when NOT to use the ORM
  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues
  • Solid REST API design and consumption patterns
  • Git-based workflows: branching strategies, PR culture, code review


Testing (Emphasized)

  • Strong experience with unit, integration and end-to-end testing
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as xUnit or NUnit and mocking libraries
  • Experience with integration testing approaches such as TestServer or similar
  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Active use of AI coding tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor or similar in daily work
  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications
  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems
  • Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases
  • Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features
  • Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when working with AI


Nice to Have

  • Azure AI services and monitoring tools
  • CI/CD pipeline experience
  • Experience in healthcare or regulated environments


Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga irá atender um cliente global do segmento de energia, com forte atuação em projetos de tecnologia e inovação, inserido em um ambiente corporativo robusto, com operações críticas e times distribuídos globalmente. O projeto envolve sustentação e evolução de soluções SAP voltadas à gestão e arquivamento de dados, com alta exigência em performance, disponibilidade e governança da informação.

O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar com arquivamento de dados e documentos em SAP (ADK/AIS), incluindo execução e recuperação (PrintList, Inbound e Outbound)
  • Configurar e manter Archive InfoStructures (AIS), incluindo catálogo de campos, build/load/unload
  • Tratar falhas em jobs de arquivamento e otimizar processos de execução
  • Atuar com suporte L2/L3 em incidentes e problemas relacionados às soluções de arquivamento SAP
  • Monitorar ambiente (Datadog, scripts PowerShell), garantindo saúde, disponibilidade e performance
  • Acompanhar capacidade do ambiente (CPU, memória, disco, spool) e atuar na resolução de gargalos
  • Apoiar mudanças de infraestrutura (atualizações de aplicação, banco, sistema operacional e hardware)
  • Gerar relatórios e indicadores (KPIs) para stakeholders
  • Manter documentação técnica atualizada e propor melhorias e automações
  • Atuar em conjunto com times globais na restauração de serviços e troubleshooting

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência prática com SAP Archiving (ADK e AIS)
  • Vivência com objetos de arquivamento (FI_DOCUMNT, SD_VBAK, CO_ITEM, entre outros)
  • Experiência com suporte L2/L3 (incident e problem management)
  • Conhecimento em administração básica de Windows Server
  • Experiência com monitoramento e automação (ex: Datadog, PowerShell)
  • Capacidade analítica para troubleshooting, análise de logs e performance
  • Experiência com jobs de housekeeping e data archiving
  • Inglês avançado para atuação em ambiente global

Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Conhecimentos em SAP ILM (Retention Management e Retention Warehouse)
  • Noções de ABAP para suporte e ajustes em rotinas de arquivamento
  • Experiência com Azure DevOps e ServiceNow
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)
  • Perfil colaborativo, proativo e com boa comunicação

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

description:

Title: Travel OT Generalis

Location: Brazil (70% travel)

Openings: 1

Start date: ASAP


Must Have:

  • 3+ years in an OT (industrial) environment within IT functions - Technical knowledge of OT systems and infrastructure
  • Specialization in at least one OT area
  • Versatility in OT tasks
  • Cybersecurity knowledge

Job Description:

The OT Generalist is a versatile role responsible for a wide range of tasks within the operational technology environment. This includes conducting health reviews, evaluating server infrastructure, creating domain controllers, and working with the network engineer to do on-site network configuration and troubleshooting. The OT Generalist will also be involved in creating and managing OU structures, GPOs, and DNS reverse lookup zones.


Key Responsibilities:

  • On-Site cutover of systems.
  • Conduct secondary health reviews of domains.
  • Evaluate server infrastructure capacity and request quotes for new equipment if needed.
  • Create and configure domain controllers and trusts.
  • Manage OU structures, GPOs, and Sites and Services.
  • Create and connect process machines to appropriate domains.
  • Ensure proper patching and security tool setup for all machines.
  • Specialize in at least one area of OT to provide deep expertise when needed.
  • Install and configure security tools as needed.

title: ML/AI Engineer
description:
• Remote in LATAM
  • 12-month contract with potential extensions


Job Description:

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join a growing AI and data engineering team focused on building production‑ready AI products. This role sits at the intersection of data/ML pipelines, MLOps, and applied generative AI, supporting initiatives such as forecasting, inventory intelligence, and conversational/agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate is hands‑on, comfortable moving from prototype to production, and excited about building scalable ML/AI systems. Key Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain data and machine learning pipelines to support AI‑driven products and analytics. Develop and productionize LLM‑based solutions, including conversational and agentic AI use cases. Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model lifecycle management, and deployment workflows. Collaborate on AI prototyping efforts, rapidly validating ideas and transitioning successful prototypes into production systems. Work with orchestration frameworks such as LangChain and LangGraph to support AI workflows and automation. Support initiatives related to forecasting and inventory intelligence, including contributions to a unified UI that explains what forecasts are and why they are generated. Partner closely with data engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, business‑facing AI solutions. Contribute to cloud‑based architectures, with exposure to Azure (primary) and GCP (emerging footprint) as part of an upcoming cloud migration.



Required Skills:

- 5+ years of experience in ML Engineering

- Strong experience with Python for data and machine learning development.

- Advanced SQL skills for data analysis and pipeline development.

- Hands‑on experience building data/ML pipelines (minimum baseline expectation).

- Solid understanding of MLOps, including CI/CD practices for ML systems.

- Experience working with LLMs and modern AI tooling (e.g., ChatGPT, OpenAI APIs).

- Familiarity with LangChain and LangGraph for orchestration of AI workflows.

- Experience working in cloud environments, primarily Azure, with some exposure or interest in GCP


Compensation: $20-24/hour Exact compensation may vary based on several factors, including skills, experience, and education.

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.

What makes us different?

Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV!


The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Backend Node Sênior #998062
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência sólida com Node.js, JavaScript e TypeScript , além de conhecimento em Java com Springboot .


O que você precisa ter?

  • Experiência em Node.js / JavaScript / TypeScript.
  • Conhecimento em Springboot / Java.
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com MongoDB.
  • Conhecimento em Oracle / PL/SQL.
  • Práticas de DevOps.
  • Experiência com OpenShift / Kubernetes (k8s).
  • Conhecimento em Cloud Azure.


Será um diferencial:

  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já construiu ambientes e entendesse de conceitos de rede e protocolos de comunicação.

title: Customer Support and Success Representative
description:
About Us:

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. At Mosaic, we design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the puzzle’s story. We are a fast-paced startup built by ex-Uber and Amazon employees. Check our website for more information:


Role Description

We’re looking for a responsible, empathetic, and detail-oriented Customer Support and Success Representative to join our growing team. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact for our customers via email, phone, and social media platforms. In addition to managing customer communications, you will help collect and manage feedback from customers to continually improve our operations. You will also support key interdepartmental company tasks to help ensure a smooth and engaging online experience.


Role Responsibilities

Customer Support:

  • Act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, feedback, and support requests.
  • Provide exceptional customer experience via email, social media, and by phone.
  • Communicate with the manufacturing team to ensure customer requests are handled with quality.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for wholesale customers.


Customer Success :

  • Collect and relay customer feedback to help shape product improvements.
  • Present reports based on customer inquiries and comments received by email and phone
  • Work with the Marketing team to manage customer feedback in organized surveys
  • Monitor social media for trends and customer feedback


Digital, E-commerce, and other Operations:

  • Ensure the website is functioning correctly and troubleshoot any issues that arise.
  • Execute digital operations audits and processes
  • Manage and update various Google Sheets used for project tracking.
  • Assist interdepartmental projects 
  • Other duties as assigned 


Qualifications
  • Full fluency in both written and spoken English is required. Candidates without this qualification will not be considered for this role .
  • Associate's or Bachelor’s degree
  • A customer-first mindset
  • Previous experience in customer-facing roles with phone support is a bonus
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to multitask and prioritize effectively
  • Attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving
  • Experience with phone support platforms such as Zendesk or CallHippo is a plus
  • Experience working with Google Sheets
  • Ability to learn quickly and a strong willingness to continuously develop new skills


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

• Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.

• Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.

• Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.

• Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.

• Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.

• Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.

• Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.

• Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.

• Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

﻿

How to Apply

Interested candidates must submit their resumes in English (Resumes in other languages will not be considered).

title: Customer Success Coordinator/Account Manager
description:
Company Description

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology. As we scale our platform, strong delivery discipline and cross-functional coordination are critical.


Headshots.com is seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to support post-launch customer engagement, account coordination, and internal systems upkeep. This role helps ensure a smooth, high-quality experience for customers through consistent execution and strong coordination across teams.


The ideal candidate brings a high level of organization, reliability, and comfort working at the intersection of customer communication, systems accuracy, and cross-functional team collaboration.


Core Responsibilities

Customer Engagement & Account Support

  • Conduct monthly check-ins with launched teams to maintain engagement, gather feedback, and surface potential expansion or upsell opportunities.
  • Serve as a day-to-day point of contact for assigned team accounts after launch, handling questions, updates, and general account support.
  • Escalate complex issues or commercial conversations to senior leadership as needed.

Training & Enablement Support

  • Lead or co-lead admin and team training sessions on how to submit usable photos (lighting, framing, attire, common errors).
  • Manage live Q&A during trainings using prepared materials and documented best practices.
  • Capture recurring questions and feedback to improve documentation and training assets over time.

Account Management & Operational Advocacy

  • Serve as a coordination point across Customer Success, Production, and internal teams to ensure customer uploads and deliverables move smoothly through established workflows.
  • Maintain regular update cadences and ensure files, approvals, and records are accurately tracked and archived.
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and internal teams by identifying process gaps, reducing friction, and surfacing opportunities for improvement.
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to define requirements and support the transition from manual tracking to more scalable, automated systems over time.


CRM & Data Hygiene (Pipedrive)

  • Keep Pipedrive records current for organizations and deals, ensuring required fields are completed for reporting, visibility, and handoffs.
  • Flag repeat manual work that should be automated and document requirements clearly for Dev.


Qualifications

  • Excellent written and verbal English language skills
  • 3+ years in customer success, operations, or administrative support.
  • 2+ years of sales experience.
  • Strong written communication and customer-facing professionalism.
  • Experience working with CRMs (Pipedrive, Salesforce, or similar).
  • Comfortable coordinating across Customer Success, Production, Sales, and Dev.
  • Highly organized, dependable, and able to follow recurring cadences.


Preferred

  • Experience running customer trainings or onboarding sessions.
  • Familiarity with SaaS-style account management or subscription services.
  • Process documentation or SOP experience.


Why This Role Matters

This position is not just support—it is a force multiplier. By owning recurring customer and data workflows, this role directly enables Headshots.com to scale accounts, improve retention, and transition from manual effort to system-driven growth.


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno
description:
Desenvolvedor de Software ABAP Pleno


*Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


*O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


*O que você precisa ter

Requisitos mandatórios

• Formação concluída preferencialmente na área de TI;

• Vivências anteriores como desenvolvedor ABAP para SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA;

• Experiência no desenvolvimento de objetos RICEF (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Enhancements, Forms);

• Vivência em análise e depuração (debugging) de programas ABAP;

• Conhecimento da linguagem de programação ABAP e ABAP Orientado a Objetos;

• Vivência com ferramentas de desenvolvimento ABAP (SE80, SE38, SE24, SE37, Eclipse com ADT);

• Conhecimento em Dicionário de Dados ABAP (DDIC);

• Experiência com técnicas de enhancement (User-Exits, Customer-Exits, BADIs, Enhancement Spots);

• Habilidade com desenvolvimento de relatórios (ALV Grid/Tree);

• Familiaridade com a criação de formulários (SmartForms e/ou Adobe Forms);

• Noções de performance tuning em ABAP.


Requisitos Desejáveis (Diferenciais):

• Experiência com desenvolvimento em SAP S/4HANA (CDS Views, AMDP, OData Services, ABAP RAP);

• Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de interfaces (IDocs, Proxies, RFCs, Web Services);

• Experiência com SAP Fiori/UI5;

• Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

• Conhecimento em módulos funcionais SAP (ex: SD, MM, FI, CO) para melhor entendimento dos requisitos.


*O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

• Desenvolver e manter programas ABAP (relatórios, interfaces, conversões, enhancements, formulários - RICEF) no ambiente SAP S/4HANA, seguindo as especificações funcionais e técnicas;

• Realizar correções de bugs, otimizações de performance e ajustes em códigos ABAP existentes (código Z), aplicando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento e garantindo a qualidade do código;

• Analisar especificações funcionais e técnicas para propor as melhores soluções de desenvolvimento ABAP;

• Criar e executar testes unitários e integrados para garantir a qualidade e a robustez das entregas de software;

• Aplicar metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil e as ferramentas de gestão de código e versionamento utilizadas pelo Grupo Sipal;

• Colaborar ativamente com analistas funcionais, outros desenvolvedores e áreas de negócio para entender os requisitos e entregar soluções que agreguem valor;

• Manter a documentação técnica dos desenvolvimentos clara, completa e atualizada;

• Participar de revisões de código (code review) e contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos padrões de desenvolvimento da equipe;

• Prestar suporte técnico Nível 3 para incidentes complexos que exijam análise aprofundada de código ABAP, identificando e implementando soluções eficazes;

• Pesquisar e se manter atualizado sobre novas tecnologias e abordagens de desenvolvimento no ecossistema SAP S/4HANA (ex: ABAP on HANA, CDS Views, OData).


*Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Informatica Cloud and ETL Developer
description:

Responsibilities include integrating various data sources, performing data modeling activities, ensuring the quality of extracted, transformed, and loaded data, and troubleshooting issues within the ETL process. Additionally, the developer will collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and support the analytics and reporting needs of the organization.

  • Strong skills in Data Integration and Data Modeling

  • Experience with Informatica Cloud tools is highly desirable
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
